Title: Su-34 Fullback
Description: Su-34 Fullback - twin-seat, twin-engine strike fighter for VTOL VR. Custom exterior model and a side-by-side two-crew cockpit on a proven two-seat airframe. Two players can fly it when the mission-editor player spawn is set to 2 slots; the package is built on the EF-24G or T-55 donor, so that DLC is required. Full loadout and mission-editor support. Model generated from scratch for this mod (no game assets were copied).
